failure_cause_rationale: Both failures are ROS2 discovery/lifecycle-query timing issues under WSL2 virtualization after multiple consecutive heavy Nav2 bring-ups in the same session (24-28 cumulative full Nav2 stack launches across diagnostic+attempts before each failure). No code change in this phase touches lifecycle, discovery, or bring-up logic -- only process-cleanup identity revalidation and env-gated fault-injection hooks that were inactive during these runs. Cleanup itself stayed fully clean (zero zombies/orphans/residual processes) in both failed runs, indicating the safety-critical part of this phase's changes functioned correctly even when the unrelated ROS2 functional check failed.
process_audit_method: ps -eo pid,ppid,pgid,sid,stat,etimes,cmd via /proc after every run; grep for smoke_test_main_runtime|run_offline_navigation_runtime|offline_nav_sandbox|ros2 launch|ros2-daemon
max_attempts_policy: stopped at 5 attempts per mission policy; classified PARTIAL rather than retrying indefinitely
